name: Biochemistry PhD (Molecular Biosciences)
summary: Biochemistry doctoral training through the Molecular Biosciences shared admissions and first-year curriculum.

publishedDeadlines.label: Complete application
publishedDeadlines.note: No year stated; review page separately lists January/February2027 interviews.

applicationFee.note: Graduate Admissions automatically reviews qualifying U.S. military/GI Bill applicants, current Rutgers students/alumni and designated scholar participants. MBS cannot grant waivers; international eligibility for nonmilitary categories should be confirmed.

english.toefl: Program expects above100 (old iBT); minimum sections W22/S23/R21/L17 throughJan21,2026; W4.5/S4.5/R4/L4 fromJan22,2026
english.note: Only TOEFL/IELTS per MBS FAQ, despite central DET acceptance. Central scores must remain within two years of semester start, stricter than program deadline validity. English-medium degree waiver subject to central case-by-case review; program FAQ lists broader citizenship/study exemptions, confirm.

documents: Personal statement (1–2 pages) covering motivation, previous research, interests and faculty fit
Transcript from each post-secondary institution; unofficial for review, official if offered admission
requirements.note: Bachelor’s or equivalent and minimum GPA3.0. Three-year bachelor’s alone ineligible; additional advanced study needed. Choose one participating program; Biochemistry is part of this shared process. Choice does not restrict thesis lab. Physiology & Integrative Biology currently not accepting new applications. Zoom interviews January22/February5/February12,2027; admitted campus visit March12,2027.

funding.note: All students in good standing guaranteed stipend, tuition remission and health benefits. Amount not stated in opened program sources.

detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.
